description: The one docker command that runs taifoon-node on a box for a wallet. The node registers the box with Taifoon's coordination layer, is probed, sends a signed heartbeat every 5 minutes and runs the work coord places on it. Taifoon is the one provider every outlet sees (Phala, Vast.ai, OpenRouter, Boundless, Akash, io.net): you open no outlet account. What your node serves is attributed to it and split under TSUL (70 % to you, 20 % graders, 10 % ecosystem), paid in GRID at the full rate or in USDC at the TSUL rate. Returns the command, what each variable means and where to read your earnings. Nothing runs from this tool.

endpoint.description: Optional: the box's public https hostname (storage, gpu, fpga) or, for rpc, its RPC URL

payout.description: Optional: grid (default, the full rate) or cash (USDC at the TSUL rate, 70 %)

ref.description: Optional: 0x wallet that referred this box (TAIFOON_REF). Earns a share of what the box accrues.

name: taifoon_node_command
